metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by byelan74 — recall (search past sessions) and savebeforecompact (keep long sessions going across compacts)

plugins.name: recall
plugins.description: Search all your past Claude Code sessions and every project's memory files — locally, with secret redaction.

plugins.name: savebeforecompact
plugins.description: Keep one long session going across many compacts: save a resume note, warn at 70 %/88 % context, reload the note plus everything after it.
